tutorial.info: The round, trick, trump suit and each player's score are shown here. There is no bidding: trump is auto-declared each round as the dealer's longest suit. By default you play 3 rounds, and the player with the most tricks in total wins (a tie leaves no winner).
tutorial.trick: Cards played to the table appear here. You must follow the led suit. Highest trump wins the trick; with no trump played, the strongest card of the led suit does.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Click a playable card and press Play. A round runs for 32 tricks.
tutorial.actions: There is no bidding and no declarer — the only choice is which card to play. But **the rank order inverts between suit groups**. In a strong suit (black glyphs) higher numbers are stronger and the 12 is the best card; in a weak suit (blue glyphs) lower numbers are stronger and the 1 is. The same "3" is third-from-bottom in a strong suit and third-from-top in a weak one.
